verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, so a user-facing feature for bulk operations across many items is a software-application axis, not a hardware one. The evidence covers parallel compute and data-processing libraries (e.g., cuDF joins and aggregations), which are developer building blocks rather than a product-level bulk-action capability. Nothing in the pack shows the product itself ships such a feature, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
